items.headline: Coleman throws 4 TD pass, James Madison cruises past Old Dominion 46-20
items.description: — Camden Coleman threw fourth touchdown passes to lead James Madison to a 46-20 win over Old Dominion in the Sun Belt Conference opener for both teams on Saturday night.
